mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_follow_notice (user_id, from_user_id, from_user_nickname, from_user_avatar, type, create_time, is_read) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fromUserId}, #{fromUserNickname}, #{fromUserAvatar}, #{type}, #{createTime}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, from_user_id as fromUserId, from_user_nickname as fromUserNickname, from_user_avatar as fromUserAvatar, type, create_time as createTime, is_read as isRead FROM t_follow_notice WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_follow_notice WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_follow_notice SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_follow_notice SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{noticeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_follow_notice SET from_user_nickname = #{newNickname} WHERE from_user_id = #{fromUserId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_follow_notice WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 1
